facts.label: scripture
facts.quote: दश योजनानि प्रथमेऽह्नि नलेन सुमहात्मना | मारुतेनेव वेगेन विरचितो महापथः ||
facts.text: The Valmiki Ramayana records that the monkey architect Nala constructed a causeway across the sea using trees, stones, and mountain crags over five days.

facts.label: scripture
facts.quote: ददृशुः सर्वभूतानि सागरे सेतुबन्धनम् | अकल्प्यमद्भुतं रूपं योजनं शतमायतम् ||
facts.text: The Valmiki Ramayana describes the bridge across the ocean as extending for a length of one hundred yojanas.

facts.label: archaeology
facts.quote: The Marine and Water Resources Group of the Space Applications Centre (SAC) of the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) concludes that Adam's Bridge comprises 103 small patch reefs.
facts.text: A remote-sensing survey by ISRO's Space Applications Centre concluded that Adam's Bridge comprises 103 small patch reefs arranged along a linear marine ridge.

facts.label: archaeology
facts.quote: In almost all of the boreholes between 4.5 and 7.5m the borehole intersected hard formations, which have been found to be calcareous sand stones and corals.
facts.text: Core drilling conducted by the Geological Survey of India across the shoal chain intersected subsurface formations of calcareous sandstone, coral beds, and marine sand.

facts.label: archaeology
facts.quote: Subsequently the sea level went down and rose +2m above than what is today between 5000 to 4000 years B.P.
facts.text: Radiocarbon dating of elevated coral deposits and marine terraces across the Pamban and Mannar regions indicates formation ages between 4,000 and 7,000 years before present.

facts.label: archaeology
facts.quote: In the light of the scientific study conducted, the said formation cannot, therefore, be said to be a man-made structure. The same is merely a sand and coral formation.
facts.text: In a 2007 submission to the Supreme Court of India, the Archaeological Survey of India stated that available scientific data categorized the formation as natural shoals and coral reefs rather than a man-made structure.

facts.label: disputed
facts.quote: Geological evidence suggests that the bridge was formerly a land connection... while dissenting geological opinions claimed coral boulder placement over sand indicates artificial intervention.
facts.source_name: Geological Survey of India / Marine Geology Studies
facts.text: Scientists and geologists disagree on the formation of the ridge: mainstream marine scientists classify it as a natural tombolo of calcareous shoals and patch reefs shaped by longshore currents, while dissenting researchers argue that coral boulders sit atop unconsolidated marine sand in a manner suggestive of artificial placement.
